# Publications

My scholarly work spans biostatistical methodology, cancer research,
survival analysis, statistical genomics, and applied statistical modeling.

## Peer-Reviewed Articles

::: {.publication-card}

### Evaluation of AI-Based Predictive Models for Early Cancer Detection

**Amevor, R.**, Mantey, J. K., & Nketiah, T. A. (2026)

*Journal of Innovative Science*, 2(1).

This work examines statistical considerations and validation methods for
AI-based predictive models for early cancer detection.

[DOI →](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18634390)

:::

::: {.publication-card}

### Equitable AI-Biostatistical Frameworks for Bias Mitigation in Cancer Prediction and Outcome Analytics

**Amevor, R.** (2026)

*JEPRA International Journal of Research and Development*, 11(3).

A narrative review focused on equitable statistical and biostatistical
frameworks for addressing bias in cancer prediction and outcome analytics.

[DOI →](https://doi.org/10.36713/epra26770)

:::
